#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <set>
using namespace std;

const double PI = 3.14159265358979323846;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n >= 100) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int a[105], b[105], c[105], d[105], e[105];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i] >> b[i] >> c[i] >> d[i] >> e[i];
    }
    
    set<int> bad;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                if (i == j || j == k || k == i) continue;
                
                long long ax = a[j] - a[i];
                long long bx = b[j] - b[i];
                long long cx = c[j] - c[i];
                long long dx = d[j] - d[i];
                long long ex = e[j] - e[i];
                
                long long ay = a[k] - a[i];
                long long by = b[k] - b[i];
                long long cy = c[k] - c[i];
                long long dy = d[k] - d[i];
                long long ey = e[k] - e[i];
                
                long long dot = ax*ay + bx*by + cx*cy + dx*dy + ex*ey;
                long long m1 = ax*ax + bx*bx + cx*cx + dx*dx + ex*ex;
                long long m2 = ay*ay + by*by + cy*cy + dy*dy + ey*ey;
                
                double val = (double)dot / sqrt((double)m1) / sqrt((double)m2);
                double angle = acos(val) * 180.0 / PI;
                if (angle + 1e-9 < 90.0) {
                    bad.insert(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << n - bad.size() << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (bad.find(i) == bad.end()) {
            cout << i << endl;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
